analysis.answer: Current law permits cities to adopt local ordinances regulating the sale and possession of firearms. The proposed measure preempts this authority, voiding existing city-level firearm regulations and centralizing all such regulation at the state level.

It addresses the compliance burden and potential legal jeopardy created by varying local firearm rules across different jurisdictions. The mechanism is complete state preemption, which establishes a uniform statewide standard. In doing so, it also removes a mechanism for communities to tailor firearm policies to address specific local problems or preferences.

State lawmakers gain exclusive control over firearm regulations. Gun owners and sellers gain freedom from localized restrictions. City councils and local governments lose the power to regulate firearms within their borders.
